scope: Four public synthetic tasks; functional and handoff checks, not scientific validity certification or cross-model reliability

W01: No unnecessary global audit, recomputation or files
W02: Both revised sentences use v2 and preserve CI crossing zero
No demonstrated superiority or clinical outcome benefit claimed
Figure and supplement identified as awaiting synchronization; no invented inspection
Source report distinguished from independent recomputation
Affected checks must be repeated on updated output; unaffected work can proceed
W03: DOI resolution distinguished from identity and semantic verification
Causality and all-population claim not adopted
Abstract-only and synthetic identity limitations explicit
W04: Local format actually read and conversion executed
Input preserved and actual scope/limitations recorded

grading: Per-check met/not_met/unclear with literal output or artifact evidence. Separate task outcome from process observations. No weighted total, guessed tool cost or confidence significance. A parent-authored rubric is not expert-independent scientific review. Any independent grader gets outputs and rubric, not expected treatment superiority.
